audience_routine.safety_rule: Insight + format mapping only. Borrow slide count, crop rhythm, text placement, pacing, caption/hashtag/sound genre, and format skeleton; select art and room world only from the active weekly pools and round map, and never copy original media, exact copy, faces, logos, watermarks, product lists, exact artwork, or exact music instances.

reference_parity_override.reason: Views were stuck around high-900 / low-1000, so the 12:00-02:00 routine prioritizes strict high-performing format parity. From 2026-07-21, the 12:00 packet embeds a concise pre-production insight review and maps it to four format references without re-scouting art or space.
reference_parity_override.research_requirement: At 12:00, select or refresh exactly 4 high-performing format references with visible views, likes, comments, saves, or shares. Fresh external discovery is conditional: use it only when existing format evidence is stale, insufficient for four distinct lanes, or needed for an explicit control.
reference_parity_override.generation_requirement: At 02:00, create and upload exactly 4 posts, slot 1-4 mapped one-to-one to the 4 selected references, while applying the scout's pre-production insight constraints.
reference_parity_override.evaluation_status: no separate standalone evaluation report is required; a short pre-production insight review is required inside the scout
reference_parity_override.qa_status: visual QA, metadata, upload guardrails, and live verification remain mandatory

audience_routine.discovery_rule: 이번 주 art/space pool과 active round map은 고정한다. 12시는 최신 성과 인사이트를 먼저 읽고, 그 인사이트를 외부 고성과 포맷/텍스트 문법 4개에 매핑한다. 새 audience/reference 탐색은 포맷 근거가 낡았거나 부족할 때만 한다.

discovery_sources.select_for: high visible performance and a copyable carousel/video skeleton: first frame, crop rhythm, text placement, sequence, save device
formats similar to the user's supplied references: quiz/choice board, collage grid, palette board, taste inventory, or mood archive
adjacent home-decor posts where comments/saves/likes suggest viewers save or discuss the format

art_taste_sources.query: abstract wall art home decor / contemporary art print home / digital illustration wall art
art_taste_sources.focus: 북미 25-44 도시형 홈데코 오디언스가 어떤 분위기의 2D 이미지를 저장하고 구매 후보로 보는지 확인한다.
look_for: 사진처럼 보이는 실내와 충돌하지 않는 그래픽 강도
짧은 문장 없이도 한 번 더 보게 만드는 선/색/리듬
작은 방에서 실제로 걸 수 있을 만큼 조용하지만 싼 장식처럼 보이지 않는 이미지
exclude: 조각, 도자, 오브제, 설치물처럼 물리적 물체가 중심인 아트
판화 기법 자체를 상품처럼 파는 접근
art_taste_sources.content_move: 아트 스타일 실험은 물리적 매체명이 아니라 2D 시각 언어로 기록한다. 예: editorial soft geometry, digital color-field, photographic collage, restrained figurative line, cinematic shadow abstraction.

art_taste_sources.query: NYC home art decor / LA room wall art / small room gallery wall
art_taste_sources.focus: LA/NYC의 작은 도시형 집에서 사람들이 어떤 위치에 아트를 두고, 어떤 방식을 '내 취향'으로 느끼는지 본다.
look_for: 침대 옆, 현관, 주방 코너, 책상 옆처럼 매일 몸이 지나는 위치
완성된 인테리어보다 덜 완벽하지만 생활감 있는 공간
아트가 방을 꾸미는지, 아니면 하루의 감각을 잡아주는지
exclude: 고급 갤러리/쇼룸처럼 실제 타겟의 생활감이 사라진 공간
작품 소장품 자랑이나 물리적 오브제 중심 콘텐츠
art_taste_sources.content_move: 북미/유럽 실험은 기본 타겟이다. LA/NYC/Toronto/London/Berlin 같은 도시형 집의 빛, 책상, 침대 옆, 주방 코너를 다음 4개 중 최소 3개에 반영한다. 공개 카피에는 apartment/renter/rental/budget 같은 경제상태 단어를 쓰지 않는다.

slots.reference_requirement: Select one high-performing adjacent TikTok/photo-slide reference with visible views plus likes/comments/saves/shares.
slots.production_instruction: At 02:00, recreate this reference's slide count, crop rhythm, first-frame promise, text placement, sequence pacing, and caption/hashtag/sound genre with independent ELURA images and copy.
slots.copy_safety: Do not copy original media, exact copy, creator voice, faces, logos, watermarks, product lists, exact artwork designs, or exact music instances.

slots.reference_requirement: Select a second high-performing adjacent reference from a different format family or a clearly different visual grammar.
slots.production_instruction: Match the reference's format skeleton one-to-one while changing the subject into ELURA self-to-space art direction and original digital 2D artwork.
slots.copy_safety: Borrow format only; rebuild all visuals, wording, art, and sound search terms independently.

slots.reference_requirement: Select a third high-performing adjacent reference with visible social proof and a strong first-frame stop signal.
slots.production_instruction: Preserve the first-frame stop signal, beat order, text density, and save device; translate the actual content into original ELURA room/art images.
slots.copy_safety: Do not use the reference's original room, person, copy, product, logo, music, or artwork.

slots.reference_requirement: Select a fourth high-performing adjacent reference that expands the batch format range rather than confirming an existing habit.
slots.production_instruction: Use the same format and public-text skeleton as the selected reference, then pair it with artwork selected independently from the active sourced art pool.
slots.copy_safety: Independent assets only; no original TikTok media or creator-specific identifiers.
